fusions.name: Frozen in the Gaze
fusions.desc: Fixes a stare on the first enemy in its path, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1.4 seconds and leaving it [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Seen Faltering
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. You bolt up to 7 tiles onto it and strike for 20 damage, consuming every affliction you have on it and adding 1.3 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Sentinel's Signal
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Second Look
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
